fieldValues.title: Examples home at the record that carried them, because no concept contains a section yet
fieldValues.summary: The spine ruling puts typed content leaves under concepts, but no concept yet has a contains edge to a section or subsection - that is #563 part 2. Each example was therefore homed from the prose record that carried the fence, which under RFC-042 Change B is the mechanism-to-be. That placement survives the later rewire unchanged, because the mechanism moves with its leaves.
evidence: No concept currently holds a contains edge to a section or subsection record
The #562 scope names the carrying record, or mechanism-to-be, as the placement
one-home went 330 to 398 records with a contains parent, 0 double-parented
fieldValues.body: The lazy placement and the correct one coincide here: homing at the eventual parent-of-the-parent would have to be undone when the concept tree is hung, while homing at the carrier is a subtree that gets re-rooted in one edge. Prefer the placement a pending structural change moves rather than invalidates.
